thread.title: Million dollar babies: 164 companies made their first $1 million from Apple's US App Store this year, powered by in-app subscriptions (AAPL)

author: Kif Leswing
title: Million dollar babies: 164 companies made their first $1 million from Apple's US App Store this year, powered by in-app subscriptions (AAPL)
text: Million dollar babies: 164 companies made their first $1 million from Apple's US App Store this year, powered by in-app subscriptions (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Dec 20, 2018, 2:42 pm 5 pts 164 publishers made over $1 million for the first time this year in the United States from selling apps for iPhone, according to a new analysis. That's significantly higher than the number Android apps to make $1 million or more for the first time, which was 88. Many of the newly successful apps…
